_comment: Strings a curate verdict REFUSED, which must never be present in shipped content. Read by scripts/check-rejected-content-live.mjs. Each entry names the exact shipped literal that was refused, the curate verdict that refused it, and the reason. The ten entries added 2026-10-22T1305Z were each verified two-sided: the literal WAS present in a commit on mainline (it reached production - the 1135Z patch shipped in ddfd3855 while its curate verdict said ok=false) and is ABSENT from the tree now, so the gate passes on the repaired tree and fails if the refused text is ever reintroduced.

The TNPSC body states per-PAPER durations only ('200 questions carrying 300 marks (3 hours duration)', 'four descriptive papers of 3 hours each') and uses 'section' only for notification section numbers (1.11.3, 1.11.1.8 to 1.11.1.12). entries.rejected_string: Start from the notes on this page, then rehearse under the clock. A typical paper is 100 MCQs in the relevant subjects over 2 hours at +2 level, so a short quiz session is not a rehearsal — work through full 100-question sets against a two-hour timer. Before you fix that plan, pin down the faculty you are applying to, because the pattern and the minimum percentage requirement both vary by faculty and by programme.
entries.reason: R1/R5 attribution: the overview said the pattern AND the minimum-percentage rule both vary by faculty AND by programme. The module's own fields support faculty variation for the PATTERN and programme variation for the PERCENTAGE rule only. Fixed: 'the pattern varies by faculty while the minimum percentage requirement is set per programme'.

how_to_add: When a curate verdict refuses a specific shipped string, add an entry here with the EXACT literal (copy it from the file, do not paraphrase), the curate artifact that refused it, and the reason. The gate will then refuse the tree while that literal is live, and pass once it is gone. A rejected string is a fact about a shipped literal, not about a rule, so a rule-shaped rejection (e.g. 'demote every H3') does NOT belong here - that shape is governed by the patch-level receipt. VERIFICATION BEFORE ADDING (added 2026-10-22T1305Z): an entry may only be added when the exact literal (a) was present in a commit that is an ancestor of HEAD - it actually reached production - and (b) is absent from the current tree, so the gate still passes. A literal that never shipped in that exact wording is not a record entry: it would be a decorative guard, not a record of a shipped defect. A literal that is still live is a live defect to fix, not a record entry.
